note: Two native variables of one register file, 1.102 and 1.103, are both pinned `two`. One naming conversion refuses both (`convert_naming`), each located at its [[variable]] entry, and each identity is withheld. A tag naming `scb/sample/two` is pruned like a dependent of any other withheld variable: one `withheld_catalog_dependency` per refused identity, carrying its source refs. `value` still publishes. Before the fix the build aborted with `catalog_dependency_missing`.
fails_if: `convert_naming` (source_naming.py) stops returning its refused declarations in `NamingConversion.refused`, or `compile_native_naming` (curation_compile.py) stops carrying them into `refused_naming`, so the tag member is reported `catalog_dependency_missing` and the build aborts

sources.description: SCB register 1 (variant 10) delivers VALUE (var_id 101), ONE (102) and OTHER (103) in 2020.
